第一步：年限是入口，完整资格要逐项核对: Step 1: years of residence are a starting point; review every eligibility condition
一般成年申请路径是年满 18 岁、持有永久居民身份至少五年；符合完整条件的美国公: The general adult route starts with age 18 and at least five years as a lawful permanent resident. Spouses of U.S. citizens who meet all conditions may use a three-year route. That route also depends on the spouse's citizenship dates, marriage and marital union; the wedding date alone is insufficient. Military and other special circumstances have their own official routes.
绿卡年限之外，还要核对连续居住、实际在美国的时间、递交辖区居住、良好道德品行及其: Also review continuous residence, physical presence, residence in the filing jurisdiction, good moral character and other conditions. Organize travel records; a valid Green Card alone does not resolve questions about repeated short trips or one extended absence. Seek authorized legal advice for complex circumstances.
从 USCIS 的 N-400 官方入口开始: Start at USCIS's official N-400 page
先读当前说明书和资格要求，再决定是否递交；本文不代办申请。: Read the current instructions and eligibility requirements before deciding to file. This guide does not submit applications.
第二步：先整理事实，再填写表格: Step 2: organize the facts before filling out the form
记录绿卡上的居民起始日期，以及住所、工作或就学的时间线。: Record the resident-since date on your Green Card and your address, employment or education timeline.
按当前 N-400 要求整理每次出境与返美日期；保留可核对的旅行记录。: Organize departure and return dates according to the current N-400 requirements and retain supporting travel records.
有婚姻、子女、税务、兵役登记或司法记录相关问题时，按说明书准备真实材料。: Prepare accurate documents required by the instructions for marriage, children, taxes, Selective Service or court-record questions.
曾被逮捕、收到法院文件、长期离境或资料互相矛盾时，先问合资格法律服务，避免猜测填: If you have an arrest, court documents, an extended absence or conflicting records, consult authorized legal services before guessing on the form.
每次提交前确认表格版本、递交方式、费用及减费／免费要求；不使用旧截图中的金额。: Before submitting, confirm the form edition, filing method, fees and reduced-fee/fee-waiver requirements. Do not rely on amounts in old screenshots.
保留完整提交副本、收据与官方通知，并记录每份通知上的回应期限。: Keep a complete submission copy, receipts and official notices, and record each response deadline.
第三步：先确认考试版本，长者例外也有条件: Step 3: confirm the test version and conditions for age-based exceptions
申请人通常需要满足英语和美国公民知识要求。先根据 N-400 递交日期到 USC: Applicants generally must meet English and U.S. civics requirements. Use the USCIS interview/test page to confirm the version applicable to your N-400 filing date. The official 2025 version has 128 study questions; the standard oral test asks up to 20, with at least 12 correct answers required. Do not apply that rule to another version or a special-consideration test. Check official updates before the interview for answers about current officeholders.
USCIS 官方长者说明列出：递交时年满 50 岁且作为永久居民居住至少 20: USCIS's information for older applicants describes English exemptions at filing for age 50 with at least 20 years as a resident, or age 55 with at least 15 years. A civics test is still required. Age 65 with at least 20 years also has special civics consideration. Both age and resident years must be met. Confirm interpreter and medical-exception requirements separately; limited English alone does not establish an exception.

第四步：选择可以核实资格的帮助渠道: Step 4: choose help whose authorization you can verify
社区入籍课可以帮助学习和准备材料，但法律资格判断应交给获准在美国执业的律师，或司: Community citizenship classes can help with studying and documents. Individual legal eligibility advice belongs with a U.S.-licensed attorney or an accredited representative of a Department of Justice-recognized organization. Ask about service scope, qualifications, Chinese/interpreters, fees, and assistance with evidence requests or interviews. A promise of approval is not a USCIS decision.
